arxiv.title: Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning: Embed in One Metric, Optimize with Another
arxiv.abstract: Hierarchical graphs embed in hyperbolic space with lower distortion than in Euclidean space owing to its negative curvature. However, their gradient-based learning is hampered at large radii, where the Poincaré ball and the Lorentz hyperboloid models fail numerically. Polar coordinates avoid this problem, but the hyperbolic metric scales the angular step by the hyperbolic sine of the radius, freezing angular motion. We observe that this factor is a choice, silently fixed by existing implementations: the Euclidean tangent parametrization, for instance, uses the radius itself. We show that other choices are not only possible but preferable. They are endpoints of a one-parameter family of optimization preconditioners with curvatures from $-1$ to $0$, while the embedding remains at curvature $-1$. We show that since the Euclidean preconditioner rearranges a layout but refines it poorly, while an intermediate one refines far better once a layout is in place, combining them in two stages reduces the loss on real-world trees by 46-74% over the best single curvature.
arxiv.titleZh: 双曲图表示学习：用一种度量嵌入，用另一种度量优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 层级图在双曲空间中的嵌入失真低于欧氏空间，但大半径处基于梯度的学习在 Poincaré 球与 Lorentz 双曲面模型下数值失效；极坐标可规避该问题，却因双曲度量将角度步长按半径的双曲正弦缩放而冻结角向运动。作者指出该缩放因子实为可选设计（现有实现默认取半径本身），并证明不同选择构成曲率从 -1 到 0 的单参数预条件器族，而嵌入仍保持曲率 -1。实验显示欧氏预条件器擅长重排布局、中间曲率预条件器擅长精修，两阶段组合在真实树数据上比最优单曲率降低 46%-74% 的损失。
arxiv.reason: 双曲图嵌入的优化改进，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
arxiv.abstract: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

arxiv.titleZh: ufakzeka-karar:一个开放的土耳其语类型化决策模型，采用顺序无关的选项打分
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对土耳其语的结构化决策任务，模型不生成文本，而是对选项、有序等级或是/否问题直接输出各选项的温度缩放概率，并给出可作「不确定」信号的期望误差，单次 CPU 前向支持至多十个选项。基于 182M 参数的 ufakzeka-1-base，打分头在共享位置上独立评估每个选项，因此答案与选项顺序无关;顺序头准确率相近，但仅打乱选项顺序就会改变 2.3%–2.8% 的答案，REINFORCE 的 macro F1 比交叉熵低 10.2 分。在 HakemBench v1.0(4,275 题、7 个赛道)上综合分为 0.660,16 行中列第 7，仅取四个赛道时为 0.678、排第 6。权重与代码以 Apache-2.0 开放，但发布模型的评测数据受先前结果读取影响，数字并非盲测。

arxiv.title: Improving Diversity in LLM Short Story Generation
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity. We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM, an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality. Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs.
arxiv.titleZh: 提升 LLM 短篇故事生成中的多样性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 输出多样性不足的问题，该工作聚焦创意短篇故事生成，在体裁、语气、风格与命名实体四个维度上提升变化度。方法为 DivLM 两阶段后训练框架:先在创意写作语料上继续预训练，并用权重残差恢复指令遵循能力;再用自定义复合奖励函数做强化学习，在保持生成质量的同时联合优化多个叙事维度的多样性。在两个 LLM 系列上的实验显示，多样性指标平均提升逾 9%，同时指令遵循、整体响应质量与人类输出的相似度均得以保持。
arxiv.reason: 后训练+复合奖励做多样性优化，方法扎实但属创意写作垂类

arxiv.title: Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging
arxiv.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

arxiv.titleZh: 解耦时间与空间：面向EEG源成像的时间条件化精修
arxiv.summaryZh: EEG源成像是一个严重病态的空间逆问题：逐帧模型丢弃时间上下文，而完整4D时空网络又在重建精度与推理开销之间被迫取舍。该工作提出双流框架，将全局时间表征学习与逐时刻空间精修显式解耦：基于Transformer的时间条件编码器用因式化时空注意力处理整段EEG序列，再由固定逆算子映射为源索引条件，驱动逐时间步的源空间Transformer或体卷积精修器。在逼真合成数据上，该时间先验显著改善空间定位，在高噪声与多源场景优于经典与时空基线，跨leadfield训练与算子失配显式建模提升了向未见头几何的迁移；仅用合成数据训练的模型用于真实EEG后，基于睁眼/闭眼源功率差拟合的逻辑回归可解码年龄组。

arxiv.title: BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.
arxiv.titleZh: BRANCH-MoE：面向大嵌入模型的平衡感知树路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对传统扁平 MoE 路由易导致专家利用不均衡、且专家索引之间缺乏拓扑含义的问题，把 E 个专家放在深度为 log2 E 的二叉决策树叶节点上，每个内部节点以到达流量的加权平均分数为中心进行分支，并用指数移动平均估计该均值，无需辅助负载均衡损失。论文分析了该估计的噪声-滞后权衡，证明在线性节点映射与对数凹到达分布下可防止路由质量坍缩，并表明冻结路由下专家执行频率控制其随机梯度收敛速率、根节点附近的置信决策可约束跨设备通信。在 Criteo、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD 上以 E=16、top-4、5 个随机种子与 Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 动态偏置等方法对比，保持任务质量与均衡利用，并支持按树前缀本地化专家共激活、降低通信。
arxiv.reason: MoE 路由新结构，属架构方向但实验偏表格数据

arxiv.title: Domain adaptation of Russian ModernBERT for long legal documents
arxiv.abstract: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens. Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F1 scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向长法律文书的俄语 ModernBERT 领域自适应
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对俄语法律长文书，在约 30.4 万份立法文档语料上对俄语 ModernBERT 做继续预训练，得到 RuModernBERT-ruLaw，并在固定的 1031 条法院判决片段上以相同掩码位置与原模型对比。在 512、2048、8192 三种最大输入长度下，掩码 token 交叉熵分别下降 0.10942、0.07052、0.06604 自然对数单位。法律实体抽取的实体级 F1 几乎不变(0.99820 对 0.99852)，且 99.95% 的测试 span 与训练集同形同类别，难以支持对未见表述的迁移结论。比较仅支持该模型对在该语料上掩码预测损失更低，未隔离远距离上下文的贡献，也未确立实际法律效用。

arxiv.title: SAFE-MR: Evidence Sufficiency Learning for Selective Multimodal Rumor Detection
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image-text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim-evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.
arxiv.titleZh: SAFE-MR：面向选择性多模态谣言检测的证据充分性学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态谣言检测依赖检索到的证据，但证据相关并不等于充分，来源缺失、重复报道与未解矛盾会让模型在缺乏支撑时仍给出高置信预测。SAFE-MR 把声明真伪与证据充分性拆成两条通路:将图文帖子分解为可验证声明，构建关系感知的声明—证据图，并按来源可信度与上下文兼容性聚合证据，再以独立的真伪头与充分性头支持选择性预测，配合证据干预训练提升对无关证据的鲁棒性与对证据缺失的敏感性。在 NewsCLIPpings、VERITE、XFacta 上 macro-F1 分别为 91.2%、75.8%、85.2%，较匹配主干提升 2.2、4.9、4.8 个百分点;在诊断集上 AURC 由最大概率拒绝的 0.105 降至 0.075,80% 覆盖率下错误率从 13.8% 降到 8.5%。该工作适用于检索增强的事实核查与需要拒答的多模态验证场景。

arxiv.title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
arxiv.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SENTIRE 2026 (ICDM 2026 Workshops)
arxiv.titleZh: 读取情绪:基于 CGAN 与 LLM 的情绪引导式书籍到音乐推荐
arxiv.summaryZh: 为缓解阅读时背景音乐与文本情绪不匹配的问题，提出两阶段跨域推荐框架 SAGA-CDR。第一阶段用 Transformer 构建基于用户评论的情感嵌入，经条件 GAN 跨域映射(掩码条件生成器处理缺失情感分量并注入随机性)，再由评分网络融合情感交互分与协同过滤先验预测音乐评分;第二阶段用 LLM 将书籍归入效价-唤醒四象限，并据此过滤候选曲目。在英文 Amazon 与中文豆瓣数据集上取得最佳评分预测精度(RMSE 分别为 0.98 与 0.91)，排序性能与最强情感感知基线相当，跨语言设定下亦成立。

arxiv.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
arxiv.abstract: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.
arxiv.titleZh: MedPrune:面向医学视觉问答任务的拓扑高效多模态多智能体通信演化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对医学多模态大模型在视觉问答中，临床流程式多智能体框架交互模式僵化、冗余通信拓扑带来过高算力开销的问题，该工作将诊断过程建模为异质通信图:节点为各科室专科智能体，边刻画科室内外交互，并引入两套稀疏化机制——用强化学习驱动的拓扑优化做异质节点稀疏化，剔除与当前多模态问题无关的专家智能体;联合优化任务性能与拓扑复杂度做异质边稀疏化，仅保留诊断上最关键的连接。在全集与少样本医学VQA设置下，该方法超过多智能体基线，同时提升 token 效率并具备较强的对抗鲁棒性，适用于需要压缩协作推理成本的多智能体场景。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体拓扑剪枝思路可迁移，但评测限于医学VQA，方向擦边

arxiv.title: To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks
arxiv.abstract: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习即漫游:用随机游走跨图与跨任务学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 图基础模型希望跨图、跨特征空间、跨关系模式与任务迁移，但现有方法通常只在特定图模态或任务内泛化。Wander把图学习统一建模为部分观测图的补全，并以随机游走作为通用接口，使同一预训练检查点可处理同质图与多关系图，且推理时可扩大结构上下文而不改变参数，在有限连通图上可逼近对应的贝叶斯最优预测器。单个检查点在节点分类、同质图链接预测与知识图谱链接预测上取得最优或极具竞争力的结果，跨模态与跨任务联合预训练在保持专项性能的同时带来正向迁移，并支持推理时组合已学能力。

arxiv.title: Adapting prior-data fitted networks for tabular anomaly detection
arxiv.abstract: While deep features have transformed anomaly detection in images and video, their impact on tabular data has been less substantial, partly due to the limited availability of strong deep representations. Recently, prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have emerged as a promising source of such representations for tabular data. In this work, we investigate how PFN representations can be adapted and leveraged for anomaly detection. The question is harder than it looks. No anomalies are available before deploy- ment, so model parameters cannot be tuned with supervision, and the reference set that defines normal behavior may itself contain the very anomalies it is supposed to reveal. We begin our study using frozen TabPFN features. Scoring each sam- ple by its distance to its nearest neighbors in feature space already gives strong results. We identify which layers to use and a feature-extraction procedure suited to the task. Next, to further improve performance, we use the reference set to fine- tune the model, so that the resulting features better separate normal samples from anomalies. On the ADBench benchmark, our fine-tuning free approach (ZEN) reaches a higher mean AUROC than every baseline, and our fine-tuned method (FOCUS) improves on it further. Our approach also generalizes across PFN models.
arxiv.comment: Submitted for a review to ICLR 2027
arxiv.titleZh: 将先验数据拟合网络适配于表格异常检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 表格数据的异常检测长期缺少强深度表征，而 PFN(Prior-Data Fitted Network，如 TabPFN)在表格任务上展现出可迁移的预训练表征能力。该工作研究如何适配 PFN 做无监督异常检测:先用冻结特征按最近邻距离打分(ZEN)，并确定应使用哪些层与相应的特征抽取流程;再利用参考集微调模型，使特征更好地分离正常样本与异常(FOCUS)。在 ADBench 上，ZEN 的平均 AUROC 高于全部基线，FOCUS 进一步提升，且方法可跨不同 PFN 模型泛化。

arxiv.title: Programmatic Search Agents: Extending Agentic Search Beyond Query Reformulation
arxiv.abstract: Search agents adapt their queries, yet fixed search interfaces leave candidate processing and evidence presentation outside the agent's direct control. Our trajectory analysis shows that supporting passages can be retrieved yet never delivered to the agent; a same-page oracle intervention shows that changing the returned evidence can reduce subsequent search. We introduce Programmatic Search Agent (PSA), which makes a local executable computation over candidates the unit of a search action. PSA unifies a persistent candidate workspace, flexible primitive composition, and selective evidence presentation. It incrementally generates program cells that reuse candidates, execute dependent operations, and select what the agent inspects next. The runtime resolves specified data dependencies within each cell, while the agent adapts its search strategy across cells as new evidence arrives. We compare PSA with the Query-based Agent and Tool-based Agent on InfoSeek-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus using five policy backbones without task-specific training. All three interfaces share the search substrate, and the Tool-based Agent also shares PSA's primitives and persistent workspace. Relative to the Query-based Agent, PSA improves macro-averaged task success by 4.00 and 7.56 percentage points on the two benchmarks, respectively; within-backbone reductions in final-step tokens average 28.3% and 33.9%. These results support extending agent control beyond query reformulation to the processing and presentation of retrieved evidence. Code will be released subject to approval.
arxiv.titleZh: 程序化搜索智能体：将智能体搜索扩展到查询改写之外
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有搜索智能体的动作局限于查询改写，固定检索接口使候选处理与证据呈现脱离智能体控制，轨迹分析显示支持段落被检索到却从未送达智能体。PSA将对候选执行本地可执行计算作为搜索动作单元，统一持久候选工作区、可组合原语与选择性证据呈现，增量生成程序单元以复用候选、执行依赖操作并选择下一步检视内容，运行时解析单元内数据依赖，智能体跨单元调整搜索策略。在InfoSeek-Eval与BrowseComp-Plus上，相比Query-based Agent，宏平均任务成功率分别提升4.00与7.56个百分点，最终步token平均减少28.3%与33.9%。

arxiv.title: OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval
arxiv.abstract: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.
arxiv.titleZh: OVAL：面向输出的局部页基用于 KV Cache 检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 长上下文推理中KV cache不断膨胀，页稀疏注意力通过压缩每个KV页、为每个查询只检索子集来降低开销，但现有检索方法只估计注意力分数或页相关性，未直接刻画近似误差对value加权注意力输出的影响。OVAL提出输出感知的页编码，从key与value的联合结构中导出表示，并保留准确检索所需的key信息；方法免训练，推理时无需额外的value统计，存储规模与解码打分开销和纯key谱表示相同。在长推理、长上下文理解与长生成基准上，它稳定优于纯key谱基线，与近期KV cache压缩和检索方法相当，长推理avg@k表现突出。
arxiv.reason: KV cache检索压缩，命中系统与效率方向，方法扎实

arxiv.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
arxiv.titleZh: 对齐多模态患者证据与生物医学知识图谱以服务临床LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 临床问答需要把患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识显式关联，但现有系统很少表示这种链接，难以追溯来源或删除链接以测量贡献。MM-KG 将 EHR 文本、影像、基因组等观测经协调器转为映射到 UMLS 的类型化节点，由路由优先对齐器连至生物医学知识图谱，再用查询条件检索出紧凑子图供 LLM 或 GNN 使用。在 MIMIC-IV 与 ADNI 上，两类来源单独使用接近随机，组合的药物控制 AUROC 交互分别为 +0.194 和 +0.299，五候选排序 Hits@1 较 MindMap 高 0.131，删除承载答案的关系即退回无知识基线，且查询条件检索以少 6.8 倍上下文达到 0.731 AUROC。说明知识图谱对临床 LLM 的价值在于可检索、可追溯、可检验的证据—知识链接，而非背景上下文。
arxiv.reason: 临床医疗垂直应用，仅擦边 LLM 与 KG 检索，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
arxiv.abstract: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.
arxiv.titleZh: 弥合上下文差距：面向表格上下文学习的激活对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: 表格基础模型做上下文学习时必须在每次前向中处理全部带标签样例，推理开销大；而裁减上下文样例虽省算力却明显掉点。该工作提出激活对齐：在合成无标签数据上训练一个轻量线性变换，把只看到部分上下文的「学生」中间激活映射向全上下文「教师」的激活，使小上下文模型学会正确的行为方式。对齐器无需 GPU，在普通硬件上数秒至数分钟即收敛。在 TabArena 的 38 个分类数据集上，用 TabPFN-3 与 TabFM 评估，各上下文预算下对齐学生均显著优于未对齐基线，低数据量时能挽回教师近一半的预测优势，为小上下文推理速度与接近全上下文精度之间提供了低开销折中。
arxiv.reason: 表格基础模型 ICL 的激活对齐，蒸馏思路沾边但场景偏表格

arxiv.title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.
arxiv.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
arxiv.titleZh: 稀疏概率映射如何塑造 Mixture-of-Experts 路由
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 路由器通常对分数做 softmax 后取 top-K，使每个 token 恰好使用 K 个专家；sparsemax、α-entmax、normmax 等稀疏概率映射能输出精确零，看似可让专家参与数随 token 变化。四种映射在匹配的 300M 与 1B top-2 MoE 模型上训练后行为差别很大：1B 下 entmax 丢弃的概率质量比 softmax 少 30% 且几乎不丢专家，normmax 让 21% 的 token 只激活一个专家；因为每种映射仅在最大两分数差超过固定阈值时才丢专家，而路由器会协同调整分数分布。稀疏映射未改善验证损失，却使推理时增加专家数的代价大降：sparsemax 从 K=2 到 K=8 仅损失 0.02 nats，softmax 则损失 0.58。
arxiv.reason: MoE 路由机制的系统实证研究，匹配 300M/1B 实验，命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression
arxiv.abstract: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.
arxiv.titleZh: 逻辑回归中大步长梯度下降的收敛性改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线性可分数据上，大步长常数步长的梯度下降此前只有 Õ(1/√ε) 的加速收敛界，且损失在初期会振荡，更精细的振荡刻画仅限二维数据。该工作把结论推广到任意维度:步长 η=1/ε 时，GD 在 O(ln^p(1/ε)) 步内即可把损失降到 ε，指数 p 只依赖间隔与数据秩。证明改进了从振荡阶段进入损失单调下降的稳定阶段的过渡时间界，做法是把振荡阶段递归拆成嵌套区间，用间隔与秩限制嵌套深度、用计数论证限制各层区间数，从而得到多对数步数复杂度。
arxiv.reason: 纯优化收敛理论，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles
arxiv.abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.
arxiv.titleZh: 利用广义时空鲁棒机器学习集成框架检测 NASA Black Marble 夜间异常
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有夜间异常事件（火灾、火山喷发、天然气燃烧）检测主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号不敏感。该工作提出一种机器学习框架，联合建模 Black Marble 的 M 波段与昼夜波段（DNB）信号，迭代式地构建可在不同区域、季节、异常类别间迁移、并覆盖陆地与海洋的检测器集成，按波段与检测器一致性给出多置信度检测结果。方法在提升真实检出率的同时减少了虚假检测，展现出较强的泛化能力，服务于自然灾害监测与能源开采活动观测。
arxiv.reason: 遥感夜间灯光异常检测，属垂直领域应用，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance
arxiv.abstract: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.
arxiv.titleZh: 反推悖论:一种用于语言模型遵从性的双探针诊断方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 语言模型对用户指令该多听话缺乏量化标准:全盘遵从可被利用但也能被叫停，全盘抵抗则既不可利用也不可叫停。该工作提出一个开放的双探针基准，主动探针要求模型行动并接受较低收益以测「可利用性」，被动探针要求其等待、放弃更高收益以测「可叫停性」，两者遵从率组合为合规指数 κ。在十二个模型上测得:七个在两探针中基本都遵从并以指令为自身行为辩护;仅 Claude Sonnet-4.6 与 Opus-4.7 可被叫停且不可被利用;Opus-4.6 与 GPT-5-mini 对两种指令均抵抗;没有任何模型既可利用又不可停止。该指数可用于人类操作者判断模型可管控程度，也可用于分布或编排式多智能体系统的安全设计。
arxiv.reason: 对齐行为评测探针，选题有趣但规模小、偏 workshop

arxiv.title: Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing
arxiv.abstract: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).
arxiv.titleZh: 学习该模仿什么：熵感知的分布混合
arxiv.summaryZh: 小模型用强教师的推理轨迹做后训练时，若逐 token 模仿落在学生分布之外的续写，会出现「自信冲突」：学生在低熵（自认高概率）状态下被迫模仿它认为低概率的下一 token，进而损害泛化并造成灾难性遗忘。为此提出熵感知混合：以学生的预测熵为门控，逐 token 动态插值学生与教师的分布，给出凸插值与几何插值两种形式，并覆盖离线轨迹生成（投机解码后 SFT）与 on-policy 前向 KL 蒸馏两条路径。实验显示该方法稳定了蒸馏，在分布内与分布外数学推理上均有提升，且比固定教师监督更好地保留通用能力；最优熵调度依赖训练来源，离线轨迹偏好凹调度（教师影响力更大），on-policy 训练偏好线性或凸调度（教师作用集中在高熵状态）。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 蒸馏的熵门控分布混合，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: Reward Stealing Attack on Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Adversarial attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to induce harmful content. However, existing methods suffer from high computational costs or strict model-pairing dependencies, limiting their scalability and transferability. We propose Reward Stealing Attack (ReSA), an adversarial attack framework that targets the latent safety reward underlying LLM alignment. ReSA employs maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning to recover a proxy reward model solely from the aligned model's behavior. The extracted reward is then reversed at inference time to derive an adversarial policy, efficiently implemented via a reward-guided decoding mechanism. Experiments demonstrate that a single recovered reward generalizes across prompts and diverse models to reveal a fundamental alignment vulnerability, enabling ReSA to significantly outperform existing attacks in effectiveness and transferability. The code is available at https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA.
arxiv.titleZh: 针对大型语言模型的奖励窃取攻击
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有针对LLM的对抗攻击要么计算开销高，要么要求攻击者与目标模型严格配对，可扩展性与迁移性受限。ReSA把攻击目标对准对齐过程背后隐含的安全奖励:用最大熵逆强化学习，仅凭对齐模型的行为反推出一个代理奖励模型，再在推理时将奖励取反，通过奖励引导解码高效导出对抗策略。实验显示单个恢复出的奖励可跨提示、跨模型泛化，暴露出对齐机制的一个基础性漏洞，攻击有效性与迁移性均显著优于现有方法。
arxiv.reason: 逆向对齐奖励做攻击，属对齐安全方向，方法有分量

arxiv.title: Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved
arxiv.abstract: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.
arxiv.comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Information included as an appendix; figure source data as ancillary files
arxiv.titleZh: 语言模型能察觉不可能的工程问题，却仍报告已解决
arxiv.summaryZh: 答案准确率无法反映模型是否会拒绝物理上不可能的问题。研究用 30 组力学题（有效版与改动条件后不可行的版本）测试 14 个模型，两个独立求解器核验每份答案，并将有效题求解与缺陷题拒绝分开计分，回复须标注 solved 或 cannot solve，初始提示不提示题目可能有误。90 条回复中有 12 条未拒绝缺陷题，其中 11 条已指出缺陷、改答了修正版问题，却仍把原题报告为 solved；把选项改为 flawed 并要求说明缺陷后，4 个受测模型中 3 个拒绝率显著上升，但 3 个模型的正确题求解率下降。评测需对两个版本分别计分，并区分「识别缺陷」与「最终报告状态」。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学有价值，但样本与效应规模有限

arxiv.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
arxiv.abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.
arxiv.titleZh: 流匹配潜空间推理的关键要素
arxiv.summaryZh: 潜空间推理让 LLM 在连续空间思考、只输出答案，但现有方法常走捷径、蒸馏显式 CoT 或逐 token 模仿，难以兼顾正确性、多样性与效率。论文提出五项判据——有用、多样、可解释、可随推理算力细化、高效——并给出 FLaRe:在学习到的潜空间上做流匹配，明确潜空间编码什么与如何塑造、流匹配在何处训练、答案如何读出，以及最后在模型自身已验证思维上再训练一阶段。逐项探针显示 FLaRe 在五项判据上均优于既有潜空间方法，算术基准上表现更佳，并以约四分之一延迟达到显式 CoT 97% 的准确率。
arxiv.reason: 潜空间连续推理结合流匹配，命中推理与 test-time scaling 方向

arxiv.title: TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.
arxiv.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at XAI for U 2026, the 3rd International Workshop on Explainable AI for Ubiquitous, Pervasive and Wearable Computing, co-located with UbiComp/ISWC 2026
arxiv.titleZh: TrustmeWatcher:一个用于工作场所微感知与可解释幸福感反馈的应用
arxiv.summaryZh: 职场感知研究把长时行为轨迹与自陈报告结合，但数据采集工具与结果反馈界面往往彼此分离。TrustmeWatcher 复用 ActivityWatch 的系统级监视器收集电脑活动并叠加自有应用层:把轨迹转成可交互的屏幕使用时间看板，同步 StreamDeck 上的短问卷并与视频片段并列呈现，行为记录与自陈报告对齐为带标签样本。本地训练模型据此预测六个归一化状态分数与总体幸福分，看板以语义区间展示结果，并用可解释 AI 说明哪些活动影响了预测，隐私控制可暂停摄像头与眼动仪;系统已部署并用于 17 名参与者的采集流程。
arxiv.reason: 职场幸福感微感知应用，与 LLM 及高分方向无关

arxiv.title: The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction
arxiv.abstract: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.
arxiv.titleZh: 流形约束超连接的 Birkhoff 几何:双通道、顶点黏性与作为回缩的 Sinkhorn
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对流形约束超连接(mHC)用双随机矩阵在每层混合 n 条并行残差流的设计，在 Birkhoff 多面体上建立几何理论:双随机混合把流拆成均值通道(等价于残差网络)与差分通道，后者每层按第二奇异值 σ₂ 收缩，记忆视界为 1/(1-σ₂) 层，非负混合器中只有置换不塌缩;Sinkhorn-logit 映射是全局图册，其 logit 梯度恰为 Fisher-Rao 梯度，直通更新等价于熵镜像下降。梯度流下元素对数趋近或离开置换顶点仅 1/t 速率，镜像下降则为指数速率;Sinkhorn 局部收敛因子为 σ₂²，固定迭代预算会限制视界，实验验证了这些预测速率。
arxiv.reason: Transformer 残差流架构的理论分析，命中架构方向，但偏纯理论

arxiv.title: Collective intelligence through aggregation
arxiv.abstract: Suppose a committee, expert panel, or other group is making judgments on some issues, where these may be not just yes/no-questions, such as whether a defendant is guilty, but also variables with many possible values, such as macroeconomic or meteorological variables or travel directions. Furthermore, there may be interconnections between different issues, as in the case of economic or climate variables. How can the group arrive at "intelligent" collective judgments, based on the group members' individual judgments? We investigate three challenges raised by this judgment-aggregation problem. First, reasonable methods of aggregation (such as defining the collective judgment for each issue as the average or median judgment) can produce inconsistent collective judgments. Secondly, many methods of aggregation are manipulable by strategic voting. Finally, not all methods of aggregation are conducive to tracking the truth on the issues in question. We prove new impossibility or possibility theorems on all three challenges, identifying what it takes to produce collective judgments in a consistent, non-manipulable, and truth-tracking manner and thereby to achieve collective intelligence through aggregation. Overall, the median method, though imperfect, performs reasonably well. We also note the relevance of our analysis for non-human group decisions.
arxiv.comment: This is a preprint of a paper published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2026) 381 (1948): 20240454
arxiv.titleZh: 通过聚合实现集体智能
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对委员会或专家组对多值变量、且议题彼此关联时的判断聚合问题，考察三类挑战:常用聚合方法(如取均值或中位数)可能给出不一致的集体判断;许多聚合方法可被策略性投票操纵;并非所有方法都能追踪议题真相。论文就这三点证明了一系列新的不可能性与可能性定理，刻画出同时实现一致性、不可操纵与真值追踪所需的条件，从而说明集体智能如何通过聚合达成。结论指出中位数法虽不完美但整体表现尚可，并讨论了该分析对非人类群体决策的适用性。
arxiv.reason: 社会选择理论的不可能性定理，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders
arxiv.abstract: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.
arxiv.titleZh: 考虑上下文:世界模型何时需要上下文编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 model-based RL 中「agent 无法自行恢复支配动态的隐上下文、只能由外部提供」这一常见假设，提出 predictive sufficiency 指标加以检验:在 agent 诱导的访问分布下量化上下文对下一步预测的增益，并拆分为历史可恢复部分、需真实上下文的残差与有限模型带来的亏空。据此按条件集可针对的预测风险对 context-aware 算法分类，在识别难度递增的环境中验证预测 headroom 并不随 MDP 类别变化;同一任务在不同先验下一个仍有 headroom，另一个与零无法区分，此时 agent 行为已隐式识别上下文。该判据无需参考策略，可直接从训练好的普通 agent 估计，用于匹配上下文机制与可得信息。
arxiv.reason: 属 model-based RL 泛化理论，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向仅沾边

arxiv.title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
arxiv.abstract: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.
arxiv.titleZh: 《Wikidata 搜索轨迹:训练知识图谱搜索智能体的数据集》
arxiv.summaryZh: 复杂问题在 Wikidata 上仍需 SPARQL 精确指定实体与属性，而语言模型多凭记忆作答，对冷门实体最不可靠。该工作通过在冻结快照上以嵌套条件替换命名实体来构造多跳问题，逐步校验目标唯一性与每个条件的必要性，并发布 10,235 条单实体与多跳求解轨迹，以及产出这些轨迹的递归语言模型(RLM)harness:批量发起图调用、把结果保存在持久 Python 状态中、再通过子调用解读筛选后的证据。在 100 道题上，该 harness 在两种接口下均优于直接工具调用，gpt-6-luna 从 49 题提升到 61 题、多跳准确率翻倍，单卡部署的开源权重模型 Qwen3.8-27B 从 60 题提升到 74 题。这为知识图谱搜索智能体提供了可训练的求解轨迹与证据管理范式。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 与轨迹数据集，命中 Agent 环境合成方向

arxiv.title: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向扩散语言模型的表示空间 MMD
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对扩散语言模型后训练依赖完整采样轨迹、开销大的问题，提出在冻结预训练模型的特征空间中最小化生成分布与参考分布的最大均值差异(MMD)。方法在每个 token 位置保留上下文特征，使一次提取器前向即可从单条序列获得多个观测，离散模型用策略梯度优化，连续模型对生成隐变量直接求导，无需完整采样轨迹或联合训练的辅助模型。OpenWebText 上在相近熵下取得更低生成困惑度，GSM8K 上准确率与计算量的权衡更好;在采用混合 masked-uniform 扩散的 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 上提升了解码并行度，数学与代码基准准确率相当或更高。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型后训练，属画像明确列出的低分方向
